result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main visible defect is the profile/avatar button in the top-right header, which renders as an empty grey circle with only a red notification dot. A minor redundancy also appears on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header (next to the 'Deliver to' address) is an empty light-grey circle with a red notification dot. The expected avatar image, initials or icon has failed to load, so the control has no visible meaning.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the avatar image or icon loads correctly. Add a fallback, such as user initials or a generic person/bell icon, so the circle is never empty. Give it an accessible label.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Keep the promotional badge on the image and replace the metadata entry with other useful info, or de-emphasise one of them to avoid repetition.
